title: Hinge Health officially welcomes Cylinder Health!
summary: We are pleased to announce the completion of our acquisition of Cylinder Health.
body_markdown:
We are pleased to announce the completion of our acquisition of Cylinder Health. Together, we’ll work hand in hand to thoughtfully integrate Cylinder’s offering into the Hinge Health experience without interruption for clients and members.


Learn more about the opportunity ahead[here](https://www.hingehealth.com/resources/press-releases/hinge-health-to-acquire-cylinder-health-expanding-into-gastrointestinal-care/) .


**About Hinge Health**


Hinge Health is focused on scaling and automating the delivery of health care. Leveraging an AI-powered care model, connected hardware and access to expert clinicians, Hinge Health delivers personalized, evidence-based care that improves member outcomes and experiences while reducing costs for clients. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
